target.title: Doctor: audit lint default selection
target.body:
## Summary
- Rebases the lint-default audit after #100093 landed, so this PR now covers only the default-selection audit and docs/contract follow-up.
- Adds an executable audit for all 48 registered Doctor lint checks now that all 44 tracked Doctor rule families have structured lint findings.
- Moves historical/advisory or environment-inventory checks out of default `doctor --lint`: legacy state, session transcripts, session snapshots, and skills readiness now require `--all` or `--only`.
- Makes `defaultEnabled?: boolean` part of the public `HealthCheck` registration contract so core and plugin health checks can explicitly opt out of default lint while remaining selectable by `--all` / `--only`.
- Updates the Doctor docs to distinguish default `--lint`, full `--lint --all`, targeted `--only`, and `doctor --fix` repair policy.

## Default-lint contract
Default `doctor --lint` is the broad-safe automation profile: static/local, low-noise, and actionable for most users in CI or preflight output. Historical cleanup, optional inventory, live service state, account/channel-specific probes, and repair-oriented checks stay explicit via `doctor --lint --all` or `doctor --lint --only <id>`.

`doctor --fix` is intentionally not equivalent to `doctor --lint --all` plus writes. `--fix` does not accept `--all`; it runs Doctor's ordered repair path and only mutates areas with legacy repair logic or structured `repair()` implementations. Some lint findings are diagnostic only.

Finding level remains per finding (`info`, `warning`, or `error`), not per rule registration. This PR audits default selection, not severity.

## Audit table
<details>
<summary>48 registered Doctor lint checks</summary>

| Check ID | Default `--lint` | Class | Review reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `core/doctor/gateway-config` | Yes | `broad-safe` | static config shape and local gateway config validation |
| `core/doctor/claude-cli` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local CLI availability check used by the base doctor flow |
| `core/doctor/gateway-auth` | Yes | `broad-safe` | static gateway auth configuration validation |
| `core/doctor/command-owner` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local ownership mismatch with an actionable setup fix |
| `core/doctor/ui-protocol-freshness` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local UI protocol freshness signal with established default behavior |
| `core/doctor/codex-session-routes` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local route compatibility check for active session behavior |
| `core/doctor/sandbox/registry-files` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local stale registry residue with an existing corrective path |
| `core/doctor/gateway-services/extra` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local extra service state that can confuse gateway ownership |
| `core/doctor/gateway-services/platform-notes` | Yes | `broad-safe` | platform-specific gateway service notes already emitted by default doctor |
| `core/doctor/security` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local security posture check with direct user action |
| `core/doctor/browser` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local browser readiness check with established default behavior |
| `core/doctor/browser-clawd-profile-residue` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local stale browser profile residue with a clear cleanup path |
| `core/doctor/oauth-tls` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local OAuth TLS readiness needed for auth flow reliability |
| `core/doctor/hooks-model` | Yes | `broad-safe` | static hooks model validation for configured provider behavior |
| `core/doctor/provider-catalog-projection` | Yes | `broad-safe` | static provider catalog projection validation |
| `core/doctor/runtime-tool-schemas` | Yes | `broad-safe` | static runtime tool schema validation |
| `core/doctor/bootstrap-size` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local bootstrap size check that catches runtime startup risk |
| `core/doctor/shell-completion` | Yes | `broad-safe` | local shell completion freshness check with established default behavior |
| `core/doctor/final-config-validation` | Yes | `broad-safe` | final static config validation for canonical doctor correctness |
| `core/doctor/auth-profiles` | No | `explicit-only` | account-shape dependent and can inspect local credential state |
| `core/doctor/legacy-state` | No | `explicit-only` | legacy state migration scans historical state and can be broad |
| `core/doctor/legacy-plugin-manifests` | No | `explicit-only` | legacy plugin cleanup rather than active runtime failure |
| `core/doctor/legacy-plugin-dependencies` | No | `explicit-only` | legacy plugin dependency cleanup rather than active runtime failure |
| `core/doctor/stale-plugin-runtime-symlinks` | No | `explicit-only` | stale runtime cleanup that may be normal in older workspaces |
| `core/doctor/configured-plugin-installs` | No | `explicit-only` | configured plugin state can be environment-specific and noisy |
| `core/doctor/plugin-registry` | No | `explicit-only` | registry migration signal can be noisy across plugin setups |
| `core/doctor/disk-space` | No | `explicit-only` | machine-local capacity signal that can be intentionally transient |
| `core/doctor/state-integrity` | No | `explicit-only` | state-store audit can be broad and support-oriented |
| `core/doctor/session-locks` | No | `explicit-only` | historical session cleanup rather than current startup failure |
| `core/doctor/session-transcripts` | No | `explicit-only` | historical transcript cleanup emitted as advisory info |
| `core/doctor/session-snapshots` | No | `explicit-only` | historical session snapshot cleanup emitted as advisory info |
| `core/doctor/config-audit-scrub` | No | `explicit-only` | historical audit-log cleanup rather than current config failure |
| `core/doctor/legacy-whatsapp-crontab` | No | `explicit-only` | shell-backed legacy crontab inspection should be explicit |
| `core/doctor/legacy-cron-store` | No | `explicit-only` | legacy cron store cleanup rather than current runtime failure |
| `core/doctor/channel-plugin-blockers` | No | `explicit-only` | channel/plugin readiness depends on selected channel usage |
| `core/doctor/channel-preview-warnings` | No | `explicit-only` | generic channel preview warnings are channel-specific advisory output |
| `core/doctor/tool-result-cap` | No | `explicit-only` | policy/config preference check that may be intentionally configured |
| `core/doctor/systemd-linger` | No | `explicit-only` | host service manager state is platform and deployment specific |
| `core/doctor/workspace-status` | No | `explicit-only` | workspace diagnostics are support-oriented and can be noisy |
| `core/doctor/skills-readiness` | No | `explicit-only` | optional skill inventory depends on local tool installs and configured accounts |
| `core/doctor/heartbeat-template` | No | `explicit-only` | template rewrite readiness is repair-oriented historical state |
| `core/doctor/gateway-health` | No | `explicit-only` | live gateway/service health can be environment-sensitive |
| `core/doctor/whatsapp-responsiveness` | No | `explicit-only` | channel-specific live responsiveness should not affect broad lint |
| `core/doctor/memory-search` | No | `explicit-only` | provider/workspace readiness is support-oriented and account dependent |
| `core/doctor/device-pairing` | No | `explicit-only` | device pairing state is channel-specific and deployment dependent |
| `core/doctor/gateway-daemon` | No | `explicit-only` | service daemon state is platform and deployment specific |
| `core/doctor/write-config` | No | `explicit-only` | write-path blockers are repair-oriented and Nix/install-mode sensitive |
| `core/doctor/workspace-suggestions` | No | `explicit-only` | advisory workspace suggestions can be left unchanged indefinitely |

</details>

## Empty/default install smoke
Source-level isolated smoke after this change:
- `doctor --lint --json` on an absent config/state under temp `HOME` runs 19 checks, skips 29, and reports only `gateway-config`, `gateway-auth`, and source-checkout `ui-protocol-freshness`.
- `doctor --lint --json --all` remains intentionally not clean on an unconfigured temp install because `--all` includes explicit state/live/plugin/account inventory checks such as state integrity, gateway daemon/health, memory search, plugin registry, and skills readiness.

This confirms the audit reduced empty-install noise, but also confirms strict `--all` cleanliness on an unconfigured install is not the current semantics of `--all`.

## Validation
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/flows/doctor-lint-defaults-audit.test.ts --pool forks --maxWorkers 1 --no-fileParallelism --reporter dot`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check docs/gateway/doctor.md src/flows/health-checks.ts src/flows/health-check-runner-types.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-lint-defaults-audit.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/flows/health-checks.ts src/flows/health-check-runner-types.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-lint-defaults-audit.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm tsgo:core`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
